source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Each Drakolithe token can enable this effect once per battle. After an enemy moves to a position 8" or less from the unit, check engagement. Use is optional if the unit is [unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) or the enemy’s move engaged it. A result of 3+ on a D6 inflicts 1 [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) on the enemy. Track the use by putting the token beside its equipped model.

engagementGate: moving enemy ended engaged with owning unit
detail.marker: place token by equipped model on use
